main_text.p: aliquod manuum agere aggrediatur, cum ex coe tu suo excommunicant. Opera enim manuum auerfantur tanquam impia, contra Dei verbum tamen. Nam ait Dominus, In sudore vultus tui comedes panem tuum. Gen. 3. verfu 19. Theff. 3. & Pfalm. 128. verf. 2. Itaque post cantillationes suas absolutas (eas enim certas numero, certisque horis tanquam pensum persoluunt) toto reliquo die otiosi stertunt. Theodoretus libro 4. Histor. cap. 11. Atque hoc ipsum vitae genus postea Monachi lubenter arripuerunt, & hodie etiamnum sequuntur, ut ex Cassian. libro 2. De canonico. noctur. colligi poteft. Quod tamen vitae genus infectatur grauissime & damnat apertissime Augustinus in libro De opere Monachorum.

8 Neque mendacium neque periurium execrantur, vel damnant, quod latitandi & celandae religionis gratia fit. Itaque impune sibi fidem suam negare permittunt, sed & iurare & peierare docent, ne detegantur. Id quod ab iis Prifcillianiftę poftea didicere. In quo dupliciter peccant, quod & interrogatos homines fidem abnegare sine scelere posse putant, contra illud Apocal. 21. verf. 8. & Matth. 10. verfu 33. & quòd mentiri permittunt Christianis, contra Pfalm. 5. verfu. 7. Hinc quoque nata est illa Scholastico-rum sententia & defensio, de officioso mendacio minime damnando.

9 Baptismi vim ad precedentia tantum peccata delenda, non etiam ad futura abolenda & remittenda valere docent. Nouaculae enim comparant, qua pili tantum enati secantur & raduntur, latentes autem adhuc in carne non item. Theodor. in Epitom.

page.notes: Transcription of the printed text. Doubtful readings: "Prifcillianiftę" and "Scholastico-rum" (line-end hyphen) are as printed. "Theff. 3." is printed in the margin-line position as a scripture reference in the text; the "V" at the foot is a gathering signature and is also given as a foot line. Scripture references are copied as printed, including "verfu 19:2" which is printed as "19:2." with an odd colon/period mix; reproduced as seen. No marginal notes are visible on this page.
